name: First token generation
explanation: Initial state 0000 increments to 0001 on first valid token request

name: Sequential token generation
explanation: Sequential clock pulse updates state from 0001 to 0010

name: Counter increment
explanation: Digital counter advances synchronously on each active clock pulse

name: Binary state correctness
explanation: Verified conversion from decimal 3 to 4-bit representation Q3Q2Q1Q0

name: Decimal conversion
explanation: Verified Q3=0, Q2=1, Q1=1, Q0=1 converts to 7

name: Token format validation
explanation: Ensures standard token format ATT-XXX with 3-digit zero-padding

name: Multiple students
explanation: Each valid distinct student receives attendance and sequential token

name: Attendance record creation
expected_result: New row appended with unique Record ID
explanation: System creates persistent record with timestamp and binary state

name: Flip-flop state transition
explanation: Verifies synchronous T and D excitation logic during carry ripple

name: Truth table validation
explanation: Verifies complete 4-bit state table, excitations, and wrapping

name: Empty student ID
expected_result: Error: Empty Student ID, Counter unchanged
explanation: Rejects empty ID, increments fault count, no record created

name: Empty student name
expected_result: Error: Empty Student Name, Counter unchanged
explanation: Rejects empty name, increments fault count, no record created

name: Duplicate student attendance
explanation: Student cannot receive multiple tokens; fault logged in audit log

name: Counter overflow 1111 -> 0000
explanation: Overflow handled smoothly, COUNTER_OVERFLOW event logged

name: Counter reset
input_data: Counter at arbitrary state, trigger reset
expected_result: State reset to 0000, Cycle increments, records kept
explanation: Reset zeroes counter while retaining historical attendance records

name: Record ID uniqueness after reset
input_data: Generate token, reset, generate new token
expected_result: Record IDs are sequential (e.g. REC-001 then REC-002)
explanation: Record IDs never collide or reset when counter resets

name: Record ID uniqueness after overflow
expected_result: Record IDs remain unique across cycle 1 and cycle 2
explanation: Global record uniqueness is decoupled from the 16-state counter

name: Invalid student ID
explanation: Rejects malformed/special-character student identifiers

name: Invalid student name
explanation: Rejects non-alphabetical or numeric student names

name: Reset event logging
expected_result: System event audit log contains RESET entry
explanation: Ensures audit trail tracks all administrative counter operations
